name: OpenTelemetry Astronomy Shop
description: Full topology of open-telemetry/opentelemetry-demo in the ArchDrift profile. gRPC methods are interfaces POST /<package>.<Service>/<Method>. Not modelled: Valkey (cart store), OpenSearch, otel-collector, Jaeger, Grafana, opamp-server, external LLM, and workers (the demo sets no archdrift.worker.name).

nodes.name: Frontend Web
nodes.description: Browser part of the storefront (Next.js client, OTel Web SDK)

nodes.name: Frontend Proxy
nodes.description: Envoy edge proxy; routes by path prefix. Envoy sets no http.route, so these interfaces document routing only

nodes.name: Frontend
nodes.description: Next.js storefront and BFF; calls backends over gRPC and shipping over HTTP

nodes.name: Checkout
nodes.description: Go gRPC service orchestrating order placement; publishes to Kafka topic orders

nodes.name: Cart
nodes.description: .NET gRPC service; cart state in Valkey (not modelled: profile allows only PostgreSQL)

nodes.name: Product Catalog
nodes.description: Go gRPC service backed by PostgreSQL schema catalog

nodes.name: Email
nodes.description: Ruby HTTP order confirmation email service

nodes.name: flagd
nodes.description: Feature flag daemon: gRPC/Connect evaluation on 8013, OFREP HTTP on 8016

nodes.name: flagd UI
nodes.description: Phoenix UI editing flag file shared with flagd (no network calls to flagd)

nodes.name: Telemetry Docs
nodes.description: nginx serving generated telemetry schema docs

nodes.name: Accounting
nodes.description: .NET Kafka consumer writing orders to PostgreSQL schema accounting

nodes.name: Chatbot
nodes.description: Gradio chat UI in front of the agent
